payload.title: Failed-build policy: read the Amplify job log before any retry; `papyrus-infra amplify job-log` helper
payload.description:
Facts: 74 of 542 builds failed in 30 days; some were retried blindly (same commit, same failure, another 12 minutes). Policy (Ryan, 2026-10-31): never retry blindly; read the log first; fix the commit or the environment, then push the fix (which is the retry).
Steps:
1. Papyrus `packages/papyrus-infra` (or the existing CLI home for `papyrus-infra`): add `papyrus-infra amplify job-log --app-id <id> [--branch main] [--job <id>|--latest-failed]` that fetches `get-job` and prints each step's status plus the tail of the log (`logUrl` is a presigned S3 URL; download and print the last 200 lines, grep for the first `Error`/`FATAL`). Read-only AWS calls.
2. AGENTS.md in Papyrus and each site repo: "If a deploy fails, run `papyrus-infra amplify job-log --latest-failed` and quote the cause before doing anything else; `redeploy-this-version` only for an environment failure (throttle, OOM, network) and only once; a code failure is fixed with a new commit through CI."
3. Gherkin: "a failed job's log is printed with its first error"; unit test with a fixture job.
Acceptance: the helper works on a known failed job in papyrus-production (read-only); docs merged in all repos.
